input: The admin setup was painful — SSO config failed three times because the error messages never said which field was wrong. Once working, the product is great.
Dashboard takes 8-10 seconds to load on my older Android and the login screen sometimes hangs. Just make it fast.
Honestly the best tool we've adopted this year — the API is clean and the docs are excellent. No complaints.
Is there a way to export reports to CSV? Couldn't find it in the settings menu.
